info.name: Kong Enterprise Admin ACLs DP Certificates API

params.name: controlPlaneId
params.description: The UUID of your control plane. This variable is available in the Konnect manager.

items.docs: Returns a list of pinned dataplane client certificates that are associated to this control plane. A pinned dataplane certificate allows dataplanes configured with the certificate and corresponding private key to establish connection with this control plane.

params.name: controlPlaneId
params.description: The UUID of your control plane. This variable is available in the Konnect manager.

items.docs: Pin a new DP Client Certificate to this control plane. A pinned dataplane certificate allows dataplanes configured with the certificate and corresponding private key to establish connection with this control plane.

params.name: controlPlaneId
params.description: The UUID of your control plane. This variable is available in the Konnect manager.

items.docs: Retrieve a pinned dataplane client certificate associated to this control plane. A pinned dataplane certificate allows dataplanes configured with the certificate and corresponding private key to establish connection with this control plane.

params.name: controlPlaneId
params.description: The UUID of your control plane. This variable is available in the Konnect manager.

items.docs: Update a DP Client Certificate for this control plane. A dataplane certificate allows dataplanes configured with the certificate and corresponding private key to establish connection with this control plane.

params.name: controlPlaneId
params.description: The UUID of your control plane. This variable is available in the Konnect manager.

items.docs: Remove a pinned dataplane client certificate associated to this control plane. Removing a pinned dataplane certificate would invalidate any dataplanes currently connected to this control plane using this certificate.
